json-key-sorter.name: JSON Key Sorter
json-key-sorter.description: Recursively sort JSON object keys while preserving array order and exact numbers.

meta.title: JSON Key Sorter
meta.description: Recursively sort JSON object keys while preserving array order and exact numbers.
meta.keywords: JSON Key Sorter, JSON, UTF-16, recursive, sort keys

jsonKeySorter.hint: Up to {limit} UTF-16 units and {depth} nesting levels.
jsonKeySorter.emptyResult: Enter JSON and sort its keys to see the result.
jsonKeySorter.rules: All objects, including those in arrays, are sorted by case-sensitive UTF-16 code units. Numeric keys sort as text (10 before 2). Array order and number spelling are preserved. Duplicate keys are rejected. This is not RFC 8785 canonicalization.
jsonKeySorter.invalidJson: Invalid JSON. Check quotes, commas and brackets.
jsonKeySorter.duplicateKey: Duplicate object keys are not allowed, including keys with equivalent escapes.
jsonKeySorter.inputLimit: Use at most {limit} UTF-16 input units.
jsonKeySorter.outputLimit: The formatted result exceeds {output} UTF-16 units. Try compact output.
